version.changelog: Initial release - Three-tier Claude routing for cost optimization

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: smart-model-switching
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. It provides instructions in SKILL.md for an OpenClaw agent to intelligently select the appropriate Claude model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) based on task complexity to optimize API costs. All content, including the markdown instructions and code snippets, is clearly aligned with this stated purpose and lacks any indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, persistence mechanisms, or harmful prompt injection attempts against the agent.

llm.summary: This is a markdown-only routing guide for choosing Claude model tiers, with no code, install hooks, persistence, credential use, or hidden data handling.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local files, credentials, network access, account data, or broad environment authority beyond influencing model choice.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact consists only of artifact/SKILL.md; no scripts, dependencies, package hooks, or external payload retrieval are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It gives natural-language rules and examples for subagent and cron model selection, but does not contain executable code or instructions to bypass user control.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no cross-session persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, background service, scheduled task installation, or memory-writing instruction.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to route work across Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus by task complexity and cost; its content stays within that model-selection guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want model-selection guidance for Claude tier routing. Be aware it is Claude-specific and may bias agents toward cheaper models for simple work, so review important or high-stakes tasks if model quality matters.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Claude-only line is consistent with a skill specifically about Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus routing; it is a portability limitation, not evidence of hidden or privileged behavior.
